data.name: Blackwood Abattoir
data.detailed_description:
CAN YOU SURVIVE THE SILENCE?

Blackwood Abattoir is a high-intensity, first-person psychological horror game set in a claustrophobic, abandoned slaughterhouse. You play as Alex, an urban explorer searching for your missing brother, trapped inside a decaying facility with an unkillable nightmare.

You have no weapons. You have no way to fight back. Your only option is to remain quiet and stay hidden.

KEY FEATURES

  • 100% Blind Acoustic AI: The Executioner cannot see you—he hunts purely through hyper-sensitive hearing. Every footstep, door handle, or flashlight click generates sound waves in the environment that draw him straight to your location.

  • The "Minefield" Environment: The slaughterhouse floor is scattered with physical hazards. Stepping on glass shards or kicking hollow metal cans creates immediate noise nodes, instantly alerting the boss.

  • The Flashlight Dilemma: Pitch darkness forces you to rely on your flashlight, but toggling it emits an audible click. When battery power drops below 15%, erratic flickering and electrical pops create micro-noises that track you in the dark.

  • Interactive Lockers & Hold Breath Mechanic: Lockers are temporary safe havens. When the boss approaches, maintain control over your breathing in a high-stress balancing QTE. A single slip-up triggers a loud gasp—and an instant execution.

  • No Pausing, Zero Mercy: Managing your inventory or reading lore logs does not pause the world. You are constantly hunted in real-time.
